mapper.sql: notification_id, event_id, account_id, type, order_id, message, channel, status, last_error, created_at, sent_at, read_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( event_id, account_id, type, order_id, message, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId, typeHandler=com.team5.notifications.mapper.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{orderId}, #{message}, #{status}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notifications WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'HELD') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.ticker AS symbol, o.side AS side, CAST(o.quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity, o.price AS price FROM orders o INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = o.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.account_id = #{accountId}
